script_text: A volatile sky is about to rattle your airy Mercury-ruled world, Gemini. Early week, Monday’s Sun in your 3rd House squares Saturn in your 12th, dragging communication delays and a career email snag on Tuesday. Wednesday saves you as Venus sextiles Jupiter, sparking a 5th House love spark with someone witty. Mid-week, the quarter Moon in your 10th House forces a career pivot you can’t ignore. Late week, Mercury trine Neptune in your 11th eases money talks Thursday, and the weekend flows as Mars enters your 2nd House boosting earnings confidence. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextile Jupiter lights romance. Friday is worst due to Sun-Saturn tension lingering in work. Send that risky text to the crush and invoice the client. Follow for daily updates.
